description_en: Kvaṃsā Bāhāḥ, supposedly founded in 1745 CE or 1754 CE, is only a small shrine on the ground floor of a private house in Kathmandu's Hyūmata Ṭola. It does not have a separate monastic building (dyaḥchẽ).Because it is the branch monastery of the nearby Tamu Bāhāḥ (KAT0810), also known as Ratnākara Mahāvihāra in Sanskrit, Kvaṃsā Bāhāḥ shares the Sanskrit name Ratnākara Vihāra. A woodentoraṇawith an image of Amitābha Buddha was placed on top of the entrance to the sanctum. Thetoraṇa, however, is now stored inside the sanctum to prevent further damage due to its poor condition. The main deity of the Bāhāḥ is a stone statue of Vairocana facing east. At the Bāhāḥ premises, aśikharakūṭa caityahas been established.By referring to an inscription on the pedestal of the Buddha statue in the sanctum, Pruscha (1975, 32 [K-80]) writes that the statue “was consecrated by Shakyabhikshu Cakrapati deba in 1754”. However, Locke (1985, p. 348), citing the same inscription, mentions that the image was consecrated in NS 865, which corresponds to 1745 CE. Because this inscription is no longer on the site (as of November 2022), it is unclear whether Locke misread the date or Pruscha converted it incorrectly to Common Era. We also do not know if the pedestal of the statue with the inscription was stolen or replaced after Locke and Pruscha assessed the site.
description_ne: काठमाडौंको ह्यूमत टोलमा रहेको यो बाहाः तमु बाहाः (KAT0810) को शाखा विहार हो । तमु बाहाःको संस्कृत नाम रत्नाकर महाविहार हुनाले त्यसको शाखा विहार क्वंसा बाहाःलाई पनि संस्कृतमा रत्नाकर विहार नाम दिइएको हो । नेवारीमाक्वंसाको अर्थ तलतिरबाट तान्नु हो । येँयाः (इन्द्रजात्रा) को समयमा कुमारीको रथलाई क्वःने (काठमाडौंको तल्लो भेग) तिरबाट तान्न लगाउने व्यक्तिको निवास रहेकोले यस बाहाःलाई क्वंसा बाहाः भनिएको हो (R. VajrācāryaVS 2075, P.252) । यो बाहाःको आफ्नो छुट्टै द्यःछेँ छैन । एउटा आवासीय घरको भुइँतलामा बाहाःको गर्भगृह रहेको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र प्रवेश गर्ने द्वारमाथि अमिताभ अङ्कित काष्ठतोरण राखिएको थियो । तर तोरण जीर्ण भएकोले सुरक्षाको लागि गर्भगृहभित्रै सुरक्षित रूपले राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभित्र पूर्वाभिमुख गरी ढुङ्गाको वैरोचनलाई क्वाःपाःद्यःको रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । बाहाः प्राङ्गनमा एउटा शिखरकूट चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यो बाहाः सन् १७५४ मा शाक्यभिक्षु चक्रपतिदेवले स्थापना गरेका थिए (Pruscha1975, K-80) । बाहाः निर्माणसम्बन्धी कुनै अभिलेख नभेटिएकोले यस कुराको पुष्टि गर्न सकिएको छैन ।बाहाःमा पाँचवटा शाक्य परिवारको संघ रहेको छ । तर एउटा परिवार बाहेक अरु परिवारहरू नयाँ घर बनाएर  अन्यत्रै सरिसकेका छन् । अहिले एउटा परिवारका एकजनाले मात्र नित्यपूजा चलाइरहेका छन् । नित्यपूजा बाहेक अन्य कुनै धार्मिक गतिविधि सञ्चालन गरिँदैन । तमु बाहाःको शाखा विहार हुनाले बरे छुइगु संस्कार गर्न तमु बाहाःमै जानुपर्ने परम्परा छ ।

historical_events.event_name: Consecration of Buddha statue (Construction of Bāhāḥ)
historical_events.event_description: As mentioned above in ‘description’ both Pruscha (1975, 32 [K-80]) and Locke (1985, p. 348) mention, by referring to a now-missing inscription on the pedestal of the buddha statue in the sanctum, that the statue was consecrated by a Śākya monk Cakrapati Deva. However, the former mentions the year as 1754 CE and latter NS 865 (i.e., 1745 CE). Though Locke may have misread the date or Pruscha may have converted the year given in the Nepal Samvat to Common Era incorrectly, we use Locke’s dating for documentation because he has mentioned the date in the local era (Nepal Samvat).
